editorIntro: A quieter mid-May weekend: one market morning, one practical Briars family stop, a soft Sunday at the springs, and enough gallery/weather-proof cover if the forecast turns.

picks.editorVerdict: The strongest Saturday opener this weekend: Balnarring under the gums, local makers, food, and enough texture to make the drive feel useful.
The soft Sunday booking. Mich McManus is the 17 May artist; treat it as bathing with music, not a standalone gig.
A Red Hill weather hedge with more shape than a filler gallery stop. Pair it with lunch or a cellar-door run nearby.
The easy rain-proof Mornington move: free, central, and still current before it closes at the end of May.
For families who need a sweet, contained Flinders plan. Book a tasting session rather than drifting through the month-long festival cold.
